passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: For discussion related to our financial condition, changes in financial condition, and results of operations for 2024 compared to 2023, refer to Part I, Item 5. Operating and Financial Review and Prospects, in our Annual Report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, which was filed with the SEC on February 5, 2025. Overview We are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service. With a presence in 184 countries and territories, our platform includes 751 million MAUs and 290 million Premium Subscribers as of December 31, 2025. We currently monetize our Service through both subscriptions and advertising. Our Premium Subscribers have grown 10% year-over-year as of December 31, 2025 to 290 million. Our 751 million MAUs have grown 11% year-over-year as of December 31, 2025. We are focused on delivering best-in-class value to consumers relative to the price they pay for Spotify and we periodically update pricing to reflect the value of our evolving offering. Audiobooks The Company continued to expand the availability of audiobooks on our Premium Service. Currently, audiobooks are available for eligible Premium Subscribers in 22 markets. Spotify Partner Program On January 2, 2025, in the U.S., U.K., Canada and Australia, we launched the Spotify Partner Program, a new monetization program that offers podcast creators audience-driven payouts for eligible video streaming of their content on our platform. Users benefit from a bigger catalog of video podcasts, and Premium Subscribers in select markets are able to watch video podcasts without interruptions from dynamically inserted advertisements. The Spotify Partner Program is currently available in 19 markets. Spotify Ad Exchange On April 1, 2025, we announced the launch of Spotify Ad Exchange (“SAX”). SAX is a programmatic marketplace that enables advertisers to purchase advertising inventory campaigns through automated channels via real-time biddable auction buying. This product advancement modernizes our ad technology and helps us to strengthen our advertising partnerships in line with our focus on enhancing our automated buying channels to make it easier for advertisers to buy, create, and measure advertising inventory on Spotify. Enhancing the listening and user experience We are focused on building and delivering features designed to increase user engagement on our platform. On August 19, 2025, we launched playlist mixing features, giving subscribers the ability to add and customize transitions between tracks. We also introduced Messages on August 26, 2025, giving mobile users in select markets a fast and convenient way to share and discuss music, podcasts, and audiobooks with friends. On September 10, 2025, we introduced Lossless music to our Premium Service in more than 50 markets, allowing users to stream tracks in up to 24-bit/44.1 kHz FLAC. On September 15, 2025, we introduced enhancements to our mobile Ad-Supported Service experience globally, adding new features that improve playback control, music discovery, and sharing. credit_strengths.text: Spotify's revenue base expanded steadily across the last three fiscal years, with operating income swinging from a loss to a solid profit, demonstrating strong operating leverage as the platform scales its subscription and advertising monetization across many markets.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure many times over, leaving substantial free cash flow that comfortably exceeds the modest annual shareholder distribution, so internal liquidity generation remains the primary funding source for the business.

key_risks.text: The issuer's debt note discloses no borrowing tags at the balance-sheet date, so funded debt may be nil, but the absence of a confirmed debt figure prevents a complete leverage assessment and leaves the capital structure partly opaque to creditors.

Interest expense is reported as finance costs, and no depreciation or amortization tag exists, so EBITDA and net leverage cannot be computed; this data gap is material because it blocks comparison with sector median leverage and coverage benchmarks.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income covers reported finance costs more than eight times, well above the sector median interest coverage, indicating ample capacity to absorb higher funding costs even if rates rise or the capital structure changes.

Free cash flow is strong relative to the modest buyback outlay, and the current ratio exceeds the sector median, so near-term liquidity and cash generation comfortably support any refinancing or incremental borrowing needs.

overall_credit_view.text: Spotify's improving operating margin, robust free cash flow and high interest coverage support a favourable credit profile, though the missing debt and EBITDA data prevent a definitive leverage-based assessment and warrant confirmation from the debt note.

Analyst judgement: the company's scale, subscriber growth and cash generation suggest low credit risk, but the absence of a debt figure and the reliance on finance-cost reporting mean leverage headroom cannot be verified against sector medians.

credit_strengths.text: Spotify 的營收基礎於過去三個財政年度穩步擴張，經營收入由虧損轉為穩健盈利，顯示平台在眾多市場擴大訂閱及廣告變現規模之際，具備強勁的經營槓桿。
經營現金流覆蓋資本開支達數倍之多，留下可觀的自由現金流，足以輕鬆超過適度的年度股東分派，因此內部流動性產生仍是該業務的主要資金來源。

key_risks.text: 發行人的債務票據披露，於資產負債表日並無借款標籤，故有資金債務可能為零，但缺乏已確認的債務數字，妨礙完整的槓桿評估，並使資本結構對債權人而言部分不透明。
利息開支以財務成本呈報，且並無折舊或攤銷標籤，故無法計算 EBITDA 及淨槓桿；此數據缺口屬重大，因其阻礙與行業中位數槓桿及覆蓋率基準的比較。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營收入覆蓋所呈報財務成本超過八倍，遠高於行業中位數利息覆蓋率，顯示即使利率上升或資本結構改變，仍有充裕能力吸收較高的融資成本。
自由現金流相對於適度的回購支出而言屬強勁，且流動比率高於行業中位數，故短期流動性及現金產生能力可輕鬆支持任何再融資或增量借款需求。

overall_credit_view.text: Spotify 改善中的經營利潤率、穩健的自由現金流及高利息覆蓋率支持有利的信用狀況，惟缺失的債務及 EBITDA 數據妨礙以槓桿為基礎的確定性評估，並須從債務票據中確認。
分析師判斷：該公司的規模、訂戶增長及現金產生能力顯示信用風險偏低，但缺乏債務數字及依賴財務成本呈報，意味槓桿空間無法對照行業中位數予以核實。
